name: Az Prototype
old_description: AZP focuses on delivering & meeting customers’ expectations at all times.
about:
AZ Prototype, Inc. operates from a facility in Mesa, Arizona, where it was founded in 2009 as a woman‑owned private electronics contract manufacturer. The company began with a focus on providing flexible, quick‑turn manufacturing services for both prototype and production projects, aiming to deliver high‑quality, cost‑effective solutions.

The shop specializes in printed circuit board assembly, wire and cable harness assembly, and electro‑mechanical box builds. It runs MYDATA MY19 and YAMAHA YSM20 pick‑and‑place equipment, offers a 24‑ to 48‑hour quick‑turn prototype service, and maintains a flexible manufacturing schedule with no general inventory. Turnkey services cover the full product lifecycle from prototype to volume production.

AZ Prototype serves a wide range of businesses across the electronics sector, supporting customers who need prototype runs as well as ongoing production volumes. Its AS9100 certification indicates work for aerospace and defense programs, though the company does not publicly list specific industry verticals or named clients.

The company emphasizes meeting customer expectations through on‑time delivery, continuous improvement, and adherence to IPC workmanship standards for electronic assemblies, cable harnesses, and soldered connections. Its quality system is built on ISO 9001 and AS9100 requirements.
